d: Bollywood is more than a film industry — it is a globally recognised Indian brand. The speaker explains how India's identity can be represented through product brands, capabilities and cultural influence, pointing to Bollywood as an example of worldwide recognition. Sharing an anecdote about a deputy prime minister whose daughter wants to work with Bollywood, the speaker highlights the industry's international appeal. The conversation explores how India's creative strengths can translate into a brand that resonates across borders.
